cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll make the coffee. I know this machine; everyone can follow my lead. This button starts it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's steam. Coffee is behind the flap. Let me show you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, the concealed controls. Show me your preferred sequence and I'll run it that way for you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One cup, please. Turn that dial or it'll make two.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, the single-cup setting. I always tailor the procedure. Keep your hand there and tell me when it's on one; I'll take over from that point.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 offers confident leadership; A3 treats B correction as familiar while accepting B preferred demonstration, and A5 waits for B dial guidance before taking over.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 steam/flap clue causes A3 corrected controls; B4 two-cup setting causes A5 single-cup knowledge and renewed guidance request.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers to show rather than merely contradict; B4 states a guest preference and useful setting.

heightening.evidence: A5 supposed expert needs B to identify the very point from which A can lead.

specificity.evidence: A1 machine and B2 flap/B4 dial make the task understandable.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 take over from that point is an earned status retreat but somewhat explanatory.
